adjudication.rationale:
The new migration unconditionally does `execute(...)[0]['id']` when looking up the old `embed_category` setting:

```rb
category_id = execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i
```

From the diff, `site_settings` rows are only present for non-default values, and the diff also removes the `embed_category` site setting going forward. If the setting was never set (or its value no longer matches any category name), that SELECT can return 0 rows; indexing `[0]` on an empty result can raise (or at minimum return nil and then `['id']` blows up), aborting the migration and blocking `db:migrate`.
